pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the server process.

log_file.description: Path to the main log file.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., debug, info, warning, error).

http_host.description: IP address or hostname the HTTP server binds to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' or '*').

http_ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS support (requires valid certificate and key).

https_host.description: IP address or hostname the HTTPS server binds to.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL/TLS certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL/TLS private key file (PEM format).

start_servers.description: Number of worker processes to start on startup.

min_spare_servers.description: Minimum number of idle worker processes to maintain.

max_spare_servers.description: Maximum number of idle worker processes allowed.

max_requests.description: Maximum requests per worker before restart (0 = unlimited).

module_paths.description: List of directories to search for dynamically loadable modules.

enabled_extensions.description: List of extensions to enable, each with a module name and optional configuration parameters.

sites.description: List of virtual sites (host/port combos) with their own document roots and settings.

port.description: Port for this site (must match top-level http/https port if enabled)

document_root.description: Base directory for this site’s content

cgi_enabled.description: Enable CGI script handling for this site

cgi_aliases.description: List of CGI script URL prefixes to filesystem paths

path.description: Filesystem path to CGI scripts directory

static_dir.description: Directory containing static assets (CSS, JS, images)

static_url.description: URL prefix under which static assets are served (e.g., '/static')

ocsigen_extensions.description: Ocsigen-specific extensions enabled per site (e.g., Eliom, TyXML)

config.description: Configuration key-value pairs for the extension
